{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuat Artisans''' were a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team, likely based on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; [[Kob Mondray]] and his fiend and rival [[Gettle Tebron]] played for them for a time just before the start of the wars.
